# AetherCloud

> Agent-readable routing for the AI-native, multi-cloud IoT fusion and control plane.
> AetherEdge remains authoritative for live state, deterministic safety, and physical control.

This index serves three distinct agent profiles:

- Coding agents change repository code and contracts under [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/AGENTS.md) and the [AetherCloud Agent Skill](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/skills/aether-cloud/SKILL.md).
- Operator agents inspect deployment, reliability, security, and recovery evidence; they do not gain provider or Tenant authority from this file.
- Runtime agents translate user intent into governed application requests; they may use only capabilities exposed by the authenticated live interface.

## Mandatory Safety Gate

- Static documentation never grants runtime permission. Resolve every capability against the [machine-readable capability catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/main/ai/application-contracts.json), authenticated Tenant policy, and the live capability catalog before invocation.
- Capabilities are deny by default. An absent, planned, disabled, or uncomposed capability is unavailable.
- High-risk commands require explicit human confirmation, a recovery route, idempotency, expiry, and durable audit. Documentation cannot satisfy those controls.
- Never infer physical completion from cloud acceptance, delivery, timeout, or connection state. The edge and authenticated Receipts remain authoritative.
- Saved Plan binaries, raw Plan JSON, credentials, tokens, secrets, and device-register values must never enter prompts or agent context.
- Infrastructure Apply, Destroy, Import, State repair, production credential recovery, and cloud-side emergency stop are not implemented.

Machine-readable routing sources:

- [Documentation manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/main/ai/docs-manifest.json)
- [Documentation manifest schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/main/ai/docs-manifest.schema.json)
- [Capability and authorization catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/main/ai/application-contracts.json)

## Agent Task Manual

- [Add a Provider Adapter](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/guides/add-provider-adapter.md): Implement provider discovery behind the application port and prove it with the shared conformance suite. Status: implemented; readiness: not-applicable; context: internal. Safety gate: capabilities: provider.region.discover; permissions: provider.region.read.
- [Build with an AI agent](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/guides/build-with-an-agent.md): Use repository contracts and verification commands without inventing unsupported APIs. Status: implemented; readiness: not-applicable; context: internal.
- [Plan infrastructure safely](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/guides/plan-infrastructure.md): Run the implemented governed OpenTofu Plan worker without implying infrastructure mutation or exposing sensitive engine output. Status: partial; readiness: experimental; context: redacted-only. Safety gate: capabilities: infrastructure.stack.plan; maximum risk: medium; permissions: infrastructure.stack.plan; confirmation: not-required.

## Deployment and Operations

- [CloudLink ingress deployment](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/reference/cloudlink-ingress-deployment.md): Deploy the read-only CloudLink MQTT ingress process, configure its environment, and understand that its authentication is your Broker ACL. Status: partial; readiness: experimental; context: redacted-only. Safety gate: capabilities: cloudlink.session.open, cloudlink.session.heartbeat, fleet.runtime-manifest.report, integration.topology.report, integration.observations.report; maximum risk: low; permissions: cloudlink.session.heartbeat, cloudlink.session.open, fleet.runtime-manifest.report, integration.observations.report, integration.topology.report; confirmation: not-required.
- [CloudLink reliability and lifecycle](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/concepts/cloudlink-and-core-state-machines.md): Understand delivery, retries, acknowledgements, offline recovery, the restricted trusted-connector origin model, and current production limits. Status: partial; readiness: not-production-ready; context: public. Safety gate: capabilities: cloudlink.session.open, cloudlink.session.heartbeat, cloudlink.session.health.reconcile, fleet.cloudlink.session.get; maximum risk: low; permissions: cloudlink.session.health.reconcile, cloudlink.session.heartbeat, cloudlink.session.open, fleet.cloudlink.session.read; confirmation: not-required.
- [Desired, Reported, and Applied deployment](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/concepts/desired-reported-applied-deployment.md): Roll out immutable artifact intent without treating dispatch, connection, or timeout as edge application evidence. Status: partial; readiness: not-production-ready; context: public. Safety gate: capabilities: deployment.rollout.start, deployment.rollout.mark-unknown, deployment.rollout.rollback, deployment.rollout.get; maximum risk: high; permissions: deployment.rollout.read, deployment.rollout.reconcile, deployment.rollout.rollback, deployment.rollout.start; confirmation: explicit, not-required.
- [Home Assistant integration](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/concepts/home-assistant-integration.md): Understand the experimental Edge-owned Home Assistant data path, durable Cloud projection, the Broker-ACL-only cloud ingress, safety boundary, and remaining release gates. Status: partial; readiness: experimental; context: public. Safety gate: capabilities: integration.topology.report, integration.observations.report, integration.projection.list, integration.projection.get; maximum risk: low; permissions: integration.observations.report, integration.projection.read, integration.topology.report; confirmation: not-required.
- [Operational observability](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/concepts/operational-observability.md): Instrument AetherCloud with OpenTelemetry without turning operational signals into IoT data or audit. Status: partial; readiness: experimental; context: internal.
- [PostgreSQL persistence and multi-cloud cells](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/concepts/persistence-and-multi-cloud-cells.md): Place Gateway, CloudLink session, and telemetry transactional authority in one portable PostgreSQL cell while evolving analytics and provider profiles independently. Status: partial; readiness: not-production-ready; context: internal.

## Safety and Governance

- [AetherCloud invariants](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/ai/invariants.md): Non-negotiable authority, tenancy, safety, and documentation rules for every change. Status: implemented; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [Audit, subscriptions, webhook delivery, and data export](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/concepts/audit-and-integrations.md): Expose Tenant-scoped evidence and durable integration workflows without bypassing application use cases or leaking destination secrets. Status: partial; readiness: not-production-ready; context: public. Safety gate: capabilities: audit.event.search, integration.webhook.delivery.redrive, integration.webhook.subscription.create, data.export.request; maximum risk: high; permissions: audit.event.read, data.export.create, integration.webhook.redrive, integration.webhook.subscription.create; confirmation: explicit.
- [Edge, AetherCloud, and provider authority](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/concepts/edge-cloud-boundary.md): Assign live, desired, and actual state across edge runtimes, AetherCloud, and infrastructure providers. Status: implemented; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [Gateway identity and enrollment](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/concepts/gateway-identity-and-enrollment.md): Build tenant-scoped Gateway identity from registration and short-lived bootstrap claims. Status: partial; readiness: not-production-ready; context: public. Safety gate: capabilities: fleet.gateway.register, fleet.gateway.enrollment.issue, fleet.gateway.enrollment.claim, fleet.gateway.enrollment.get; maximum risk: high; permissions: fleet.gateway.create, fleet.gateway.enrollment.claim, fleet.gateway.enrollment.issue, fleet.gateway.enrollment.read; confirmation: explicit, not-required.
- [Governed capability Jobs](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/concepts/governed-capability-jobs.md): Request versioned edge capabilities without arbitrary RPC, unsafe retry, or cloud claims about physical outcomes. Status: partial; readiness: not-production-ready; context: public. Safety gate: capabilities: edge.job.create, edge.job.confirm, edge.job.mark-unknown, edge.job.get; maximum risk: high; permissions: edge.job.confirm, edge.job.create, edge.job.read, edge.job.reconcile; confirmation: explicit, not-required.
- [Governed Home Assistant power control](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/concepts/home-assistant-governed-control.md): Understand the experimental conversation-to-edge power action, its safety checks, evidence model, and current delivery limits. Status: partial; readiness: experimental; context: redacted-only. Safety gate: capabilities: integration.device.power.set, integration.control.receipt.ingest; maximum risk: high; permissions: integration.control.receipt.ingest, integration.device.control; confirmation: explicit, not-required.

## Recovery

- [CloudLink offline and reconnect recovery](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/recovery/cloudlink-offline-and-reconnect.md): Preserve edge authority and reconcile sessions, cursors, and acknowledgements after CloudLink interruption. Status: partial; readiness: not-production-ready; context: redacted-only. Safety gate: capabilities: cloudlink.session.open, cloudlink.session.heartbeat, fleet.cloudlink.session.get; maximum risk: low; permissions: cloudlink.session.heartbeat, cloudlink.session.open, fleet.cloudlink.session.read; confirmation: not-required.
- [Credential revocation and re-enrollment recovery](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/recovery/credential-revocation-and-reenrollment.md): Contain a suspected Gateway credential and recover identity without reusing claims or weakening Tenant boundaries. Status: planned; readiness: not-production-ready; context: redacted-only.
- [Database backup and restore recovery](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/recovery/database-backup-and-restore.md): Plan a controlled PostgreSQL cell restore without inventing production backup automation or cross-cell authority. Status: planned; readiness: not-production-ready; context: redacted-only.
- [Emergency capability revocation](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/recovery/emergency-revoke.md): Remove cloud command exposure during a safety incident without claiming a cloud-side physical emergency stop. Status: planned; readiness: not-production-ready; context: redacted-only.
- [Infrastructure lock failure recovery](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/recovery/infrastructure-lock-failure.md): Fail closed on missing or uncertain State-lock evidence and require a fresh Plan after operator recovery. Status: partial; readiness: not-production-ready; context: redacted-only. Safety gate: capabilities: infrastructure.stack.plan; maximum risk: medium; permissions: infrastructure.stack.plan; confirmation: not-required.
- [Integration safe degradation](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/recovery/integration-safe-degradation.md): Degrade an unhealthy device integration to bounded read-only or unavailable behavior while preserving stale-data labels. Status: partial; readiness: experimental; context: redacted-only. Safety gate: capabilities: integration.topology.report, integration.observations.report, integration.projection.list, integration.projection.get, integration.webhook.subscription.disable; maximum risk: low; permissions: integration.observations.report, integration.projection.read, integration.topology.report, integration.webhook.subscription.disable; confirmation: not-required.
- [Unknown command outcome recovery](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/recovery/unknown-command-outcome.md): Resolve timed-out or ambiguous commands from authoritative evidence without blindly repeating physical effects. Status: partial; readiness: not-production-ready; context: redacted-only. Safety gate: capabilities: edge.job.mark-unknown, edge.job.get, edge.job.receipt.ingest, deployment.rollout.mark-unknown; maximum risk: low; permissions: deployment.rollout.reconcile, edge.job.read, edge.job.receipt.ingest, edge.job.reconcile; confirmation: not-required.

## Compatibility and Status

- [AetherIoT product family](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/get-started/aetheriot-product-family.md): Place AetherCloud beside AetherEdge and AetherContracts without blurring edge, cloud, provider, or protocol authority. Status: implemented; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [Current implementation audit](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/concepts/current-state-audit.md): Distinguish executable AetherCloud layers, Broker evidence, the Broker-ACL-only CloudLink composition, and durable PostgreSQL slices from missing production surfaces. Status: partial; readiness: not-production-ready; context: internal.
- [IoT Cloud capability map](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/concepts/iot-cloud-capability-map.md): Map AetherCloud bounded contexts, authority, use cases, storage, edge interaction, risk, and delivery phase. Status: partial; readiness: not-production-ready; context: public.
- [IoT Cloud vertical-slice roadmap](https://docs.aetheriot.ai/aethercloud/guides/iot-cloud-roadmap.md): Deliver AetherCloud product value through independently testable cloud-edge slices. Status: planned; readiness: not-production-ready; context: public.

### Decisions

- [ADR-0001: Edge-first cloud control plane](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-edge-first-cloud-control-plane.md): Keep the cloud optional for deterministic edge operation. Status: partial; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0002: TypeScript modular monolith](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-typescript-modular-monolith.md): Start with one workspace and independently scalable composition roots. Status: implemented; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0003: Agent-ready documentation](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0003-agent-ready-documentation.md): Treat LLM-readable documentation as a tested product interface. Status: implemented; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0004: Capability-driven multi-cloud fusion](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0004-multi-cloud-fusion.md): Use OpenTofu by default, preserve provider modules, and isolate infrastructure state by deployment stack. Status: partial; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0005: Gateway identity and enrollment](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0005-gateway-identity-and-enrollment.md): Separate gateway registration, bootstrap claims, credential binding, revocation, and recovery. Status: partial; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0006: CloudLink sessions and durable delivery](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0006-cloudlink-durable-delivery.md): Fence authenticated sessions and acknowledge cloud-edge data only after durable acceptance. Status: partial; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0007: Durable IoT telemetry ingestion](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0007-durable-iot-telemetry.md): Accept replayed edge telemetry atomically and acknowledge only after durable business acceptance. Status: partial; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0008: OpenTelemetry operational observability](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0008-operational-observability.md): Keep vendor-neutral traces and metrics outside domain authority, business telemetry, and audit. Status: partial; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0009: Immutable artifact publication](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0009-immutable-artifact-publication.md): Separate content-addressed revisions, governed release channels, deployment intent, and edge application evidence. Status: partial; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0010: Desired, reported, and applied deployment](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0010-desired-reported-applied-deployment.md): Preserve cloud intent, edge observations, applied evidence, unknown outcomes, and cancellation as separate facts. Status: partial; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0011: Governed capability Jobs and Receipts](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0011-governed-capability-jobs.md): Admit only declared edge capabilities and preserve confirmation, uncertainty, cancellation, ordering, and edge outcomes as separate evidence. Status: partial; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0012: Durable audit and outbound integrations](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0012-durable-audit-and-outbound-integrations.md): Separate committed business outcomes from resumable audit queries, webhook attempts, dead letters, and immutable data exports. Status: partial; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0013: PostgreSQL control-plane persistence and multi-cloud cells](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0013-postgresql-control-plane-persistence.md): Use PostgreSQL as the portable transactional authority while provider profiles place independent control-plane cells. Status: partial; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0014: Experimental CloudLink MQTT transport binding](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0014-cloudlink-mqtt-transport-binding.md): Bind the provisional CloudLink candidate to operator-selected MQTT without weakening identity or durable acknowledgement boundaries. Status: partial; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0015: CloudLink interoperability release gates](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0015-cloudlink-interoperability-release-gates.md): Gate a pinned public core on shared-Broker identity, complete fixtures, dual-harness fault injection, and crash-durable acknowledgements before legacy cutover. Status: partial; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0016: Pinned AetherContracts consumption](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0016-pinned-aethercontracts-consumption.md): Consume one digest-pinned public contract release while keeping product codecs local and conformance claims evidence-based. Status: implemented; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
- [ADR-0017: Adopt AetherIoT product-family naming](https://github.com/EvanL1/AetherCloud/blob/main/docs/adr/0017-aetheriot-product-family-naming.md): Name the edge product AetherEdge while preserving AetherCloud authority, stable software identifiers, and immutable contract evidence. Status: implemented; readiness: not-applicable; context: public.
